# Stoicism - Praxis

## Daily Stoic, Journal

Free · In‑App Purchases · Designed for iPad

Share

iPhone, iPad

Praxis - Your Digital Stoic Practice Apply ancient philosophy to modern life with Stoicism: Praxis. Go beyond reading quotes to practicing the principles that shaped history's greatest minds. This app combines structured learning, intelligent journaling, and daily practice tools to help you master your mindset and become your best self. AI-Enhanced Learning & Reflection Stoic AI Chat: Ask questions and explore philosophical concepts with an AI trained on Marcus Aurelius, Seneca, and Epictetus. Get perspective on daily challenges through a Stoic lens. Journal Analysis: Get thoughtful Stoic perspective on your journal entries. Stoicism: Praxis offers relevant philosophical commentary and suggestions to deepen your reflection practice. Guided Templates: Use structured prompts for morning planning, evening review, gratitude practice, and fear-setting. Each template connects to specific Stoic exercises used by ancient practitioners. Daily Virtue Practice Four Virtues Tracking: Monitor your development in Wisdom, Justice, Courage, and Temperance. Stoicism: Praxis provides simple tools to track what matters most in Stoic philosophy. Home Screen Widgets: Daily Stoic quotes and practice reminders keep philosophical principles visible throughout your day. There's also a Memento Mori widget! Memento Mori Visualization: Contemplate the preciousness of time by seeing your life as a grid of dots where each dot represents a week or year. Filled dots show time already lived, empty space reveals what remains. Cultivate urgency, gratitude, and perspective on what truly matters. Morning & Evening Routines: Establish the reflection practices that ancient Stoics used for preparation and review. Build consistency with gentle reminders and progress tracking. Structured Courses & Exercises Learning Paths: Work through courses designed around real-world applications of Stoic philosophy. Learn frameworks for decision-making, emotional regulation, and principled living that you can use immediately. Practical Exercises: Practice negative visualization, gratitude, and other traditional Stoic techniques. Stoicism: Praxis guides you through exercises with clear instructions and reflection prompts. Progress Insights: See your learning journey and practice consistency. Track which areas you're developing and where to focus next. Clean, Focused Design Distraction-Free Interface: Praxis prioritizes your practice over notifications and social features. The design supports deep reflection and learning. Dark & Light Mode Support: Choose the appearance that works best for your reflection time and environment. Whether you're new to Stoicism or deepening an existing practice, the app provides tools for consistent growth in wisdom and character. ------ Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

# Stoic Quotes & Journal – Stojo

## Stoicism Prompts & Reflection

Free · In‑App Purchases · Designed for iPad

Share

iPhone, iPad

 Bring timeless Stoic wisdom into your day. Read a quote, reflect with a guided prompt, and write in private to build calm focus, self-discipline, and clarity that lasts! Start your day a little slower, taking a breath before everything begins to move. Stojo brings Stoic reflection into real life through small, simple habits you can actually keep. Each morning, a short quote and a few gentle lines invite you to pause, write a bit, and notice what matters most. Open Stojo, jot down a few thoughts, and begin your day feeling grounded and clear! Reflect with Intention Stojo is built around the idea that philosophy only matters when you live it. Each quote or journaling prompt is a chance to pause and ask yourself how those words fit your day. Some days you’ll write a lot, others just a few sentences. What matters is the habit of reflection. These small pauses often bring more understanding than hours of overthinking. Your Thoughts Stay Yours It’s your quiet corner to write, just between you and the page. With time, it begins to feel familiar, almost like a space that listens while you untangle your thoughts. Many people describe Stojo as the first place they’ve felt safe enough to write freely again. Notice Your Progress The change you’ll feel is quiet but steady. Stojo shows gentle reminders of how your writing grows, how many days you’ve written, how many words you’ve added. You might start to see patterns in what worries you or notice that old frustrations fade faster. It’s not about tracking for perfection but seeing proof of how steady reflection adds up. Ancient Ideas, Modern Clarity At its heart, Stoicism teaches calm in motion. You pause, breathe, and focus on what’s within reach. That small moment can change how the whole day feels. A Habit That Shapes Character At first, Stojo feels like a journaling app. Then it becomes a quiet routine that steadies your mind. You begin to expect that pause, that few minutes of writing that help you reset. Over time, the changes appear quietly, with less noise in your thoughts, more patience in your actions, and a clearer view when things get difficult. That’s the Stoic idea of discipline, balance built over time. Why People Enjoy Using Stojo Most start to ease stress, then keep going because it helps them stay centered. - It helps ease stress and bring a sense of calm. - It keeps thoughts grounded through short daily reflections. - It encourages awareness instead of quick reactions. - It turns journaling into a steady habit that feels natural. Stojo doesn’t offer instant change, but over time it builds real progress and a deeper sense of clarity. Download the app today and see how a few quiet minutes can shift your whole day! Write, pause, and reconnect with calm through daily Stoic reflection. Start small and watch how clarity grows each time you sit down to reflect! --- Subscription Some features require a subscription. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You’ll retain access until the end of your billing cycle. Stoic App Features | Journaling, Mood Tracking & Daily Reflection Tools

# features.

More than a journaling app, stoic is your go-to resource for exploring stoicism and philosophy, mental well-being, happiness, productivity, relationships, and practical tips for living a fulfilled life.

## Journaling Inspiration and Guidance

### Daily Reflections

Begin and end your day with easily customizable reflections to keep your self-care practice intentional and fulfilling.

### Daily Prompts

Not sure what to journal about? Daily prompts are here to inspire you. Keep an eye out for a new prompt each day, and a new theme every week.

### Guided Journals

Explore a collection of thematic guided journals on topics that matter most. Revisit and explore them anytime.

## Helpful Tools for Building Your Habit

### Progress Tracking

Monitor your mood and mark the factors that influence it. Soon, you'll discover patterns and get insights to help you feel your best.

### Streaks & Badges

With fun rewards, staying motivated is easy! Build your streaks and unlock badges along the way. Can you collect them all?

### Gentle Notifications

Set smart reminders so you don't forget to log your mood or journal to stay consistent without disrupting your day.

## Write Your Own Journey

### Journaling History

Take a trip down memory lane whenever you want. Revisit your past entries to see how far you’ve come.

### Personalized Insights

Get valuable feedback and insights based on your daily entries and activities to better understand what influences your life.

### Treasured Memories

Go back to the most meaningful moments of your life and reflect on the memories that matter most.

## Mindful Exercises

### Meditation

Practice mindfulness through guided meditation sessions designed to center and calm your mind.

### Breathing

Improve your stress management and focus with simple, easy-to-follow guided breathing exercises.

### Writing Goals

Stay consistent with your journaling by setting personalized writing goals and celebrating your progress along the way.

## Words of Wisdom

### Quotes & Daily Affirmations

Get daily insights from the wisdom of notable thinkers, and practice gratitude by regularly reading and reflecting on affirmations.

### Collections & Resources

Explore a curated library of collections and resources for deeper learning on essential topics such as sleep, mental health, journaling, productivity, and more.

### Themed Events

Celebrate special occasions such as holidays and events with thoughtfully prepared journals, exercises, and lessons.

## There’s More!

### Privacy & Security

Rest assured, only you have access to your data. It’s securely stored on your devices and Apple iCloud, with every precaution taken to protect your personal writings.

### On All Your Devices

Stay connected and seamlessly switch your writings between your iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and MacBook.

### Community

Join a supportive community where you can share your reflections, participate in discussions, and find encouragement.

## Step into the stoic world!

Download the app to explore journals, lessons, quotes, affirmations, and all the inspiration you need.
